content:
maria.partners: Quick heads-up — we're locking the QBR slide for the HW marketplace co-launch; need final scorecard numbers and MDF ask by EOD tomorrow.
ajay-sales: Ack. pulling last quarter ARR and pipeline; will send a csv in #partnerships-docs. Any target tiers we want them to be listed under?
kelly-marketing: For announcement copy we need partner logo high-res + 2-sentence blurb. Can partners provide by Tue?
noah-eng: From infra side, need a listing tag for 'redwood-verified' GPU support. Can we get model/instance list?
maria.partners: ajay — propose Tier A for partners hitting >$50k commit, Tier B for >$10k. Thoughts?
ajay-sales: Looks fine, but can we add an escape hatch for SI pre-sales credits? maybe make it conditional.
kelly-marketing: MDF ask: suggest $30k pool split 60/40 marketing vs co-sell enablement. approve?
ajay-sales: +1 to that split.
maria.partners: ok locking MDF ask $30k. ajay, pls make spreadsheet with allocation per partner and expected deliverables.
ajay-sales: will drop in #partnerships-docs: /files/marketplace_mdf_alloc_3182468100.csv
maria.partners: Also need QBR scorecard metrics: revenue motion, pipeline influenced, joint announcements count, marketplace listing health (clicks/installs). e.g., use metrics template: https://docs.redwood.com/partners/scorecard-template
kelly-marketing: tagging product-ops for measurement: @noah-eng can you add click telemetry to dashboard by next Monday?
noah-eng: putting a ticket in — infra-analytics#4321. ETA Mon EOD.
partner-bot: Reminder: partner contract 12345 renewal alert — 30 days remaining :bell:
maria.partners: Thanks all. i'll compile and send PR to the QBR deck by Friday. Please add any last items in thread.
